[[Frost Invasion Event]] (Non-canon) }} ==Description== The '''Frost Realm''' is one of the many realms that exist within the world of Tower Defense Simulator. It was first canonically introduced in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]], acting as the home-world for the monsters that the [[Children of Exo]] used to siege [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]]. According to the [[Dispatcher]], the '''Frost Realm''' reaches temperatures as cold as -224°C, or -371°F. A particular phenomenon exists within the '''Frost Realm''' where ice can contain "''raw, unfiltered energy''". This energized ice or snow is the basis for life in the '''Frost Realm'''.{{InlineQuote|Intel is in about the Frost Realm. Their ice contains raw, unfiltered energy. Their world reaches temperature as cold as -224°C (-371°F).|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 24/37 ([[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]])}} In folklore within the [[Overworld]], the '''Frost Realm''' is known as a separate plane of existence, called the "''Frozen Realm''". Many creatures from the '''Frost Realm''' are referred to as that hosts the departed souls of people lost in snowstorms{{InlineQuote|Legend has it that they are the spirits of those who were lost during snowstorms and passed into the Frozen Realm.|[[Frozen]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description}} or those who fall into frozen lakes.{{InlineQuote|According to legend, these beings are created from those who fall through frozen lakes and never resurface. The shadowy figure visible within is believed to be one of these unfortunate souls.|[[Frost Mystery]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description}} More information on the '''Frost Realm''' is revealed in the non-canon [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. While the events in that mode are not canon, the descriptions of the '''Frost Realm''' contain noteworthy information that likely is true to some degree. In that mode, the '''Frost Realm''' is described as a structured society, containing cities and military bases. While similar to the [[Overworld]], the cities in specific are stated to be more primitive than the ones used by humans.{{InlineQuote|In the few pictures we transmitted, it shows a massive city carved completely out of ice and stone. Primitive by our standards, but the designs are impressive!|[[Professor V]] on Wave 16 ([[Frost Mode|Frost]])}}{{InlineQuote|Aside from chains hanging everywhere? It seems like a structured society. The portal also leads into a militarized area, (...)|[[Professor V]] on Wave 32 ([[Frost Mode|Frost]])}} ==Inhabitants== A plethora of frost creatures inhabit the '''Frost Realm''', being quite diverse in form. But despite this, a common factor shared by most creatures native to the '''Frost Realm''' is that they originate from energized ice.The [[Frost Spirit]] is directly referred to as being a massive concentration of that energy, meaning the other enemies would also likely be made of it.
{{InlineQuote|Their ice contains raw, unfiltered energy.|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 24/37 ([[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]])}}
{{InlineQuote|I just got word that a massive concentration of that energy is heading straight for us.|[[Professor V]] on Wave 24/37 ([[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]])}} The enemies seen in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]] and the non-canon [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode are just some of the living beings seen to come from the '''Frost Realm''', but there are also other creatures that come from the realm not seen in them, such as "''Crystal Horns''", which are harvested for their wool{{InlineQuote|Their capes, crafted from fine Crystal Horn wool, (...)|[[Frost Invader]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description}}, and "''Crystallized Frost Spinners''", which are harvested for their silk.{{InlineQuote|Adorned with the finest crystallized armor and woven Crystalline Frost Spinner silk, (...)|[[Frost Hero]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description}} ==Groups== The primary faction that dominates the '''Frost Realm''' is the Frost Army. Being one of the most powerful beings in the '''Frost Realm''', the [[Frost Spirit]] is the leader and figure of worship to this army. Comprising the ranks of the Frost Army are soldiers, such as the [[Packed Ice]], [[Deep Freeze]] or [[Frost Invader]]. There are also dedicated worshipers, such as [[Crying Angel]]s{{InlineQuote|The Crying Angel is a follower of the Frost Spirit. It is created when devoted members of the Frost Army undergoes handpicked transformation.|[[Crying Angel]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description}} and [[Frost Mage|Frost Mages]].{{InlineQuote|Frost Mages are envied by the Crying Angels for reaching sainthood in their beliefs where the Frost Spirit grants them a portion of its power.|[[Frost Mage]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description}} ==Locations== ===Frost Spirit's Castle=== {{LocationInfobox |title = Frost Spirit's Castle |image = [[File:Frostspiritscathedral.jpg]] |purpose = Fortress |creator = [[Frost Spirit]] |owner = [[Frost Spirit]] }} Residing in an unknown part of the '''Frost Realm''', the [[Frost Spirit]]'s cathedral-like castle{{InlineQuote|These transformed creatures now circle above the Frost Spirit's cathedral-like castle, tirelessly waiting for their next orders.|[[Crying Angel]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description}} is a focal point for the Frost Army, serving as the resting place for the [[Frost Spirit]] and place of worship for his followers. In the [[Operation I.C.E Event]], the [[Children of Exo]] entered the castle, awakening the [[Frost Spirit]] with a fragment of the [[God Cube]]. {{Clear}} ==Trivia== *The '''Frost Realm''' was the first realm introduced by name in the Tower Defense Simulator storyline, making its appearance in the now de-canonized [[Frost Invasion Event]] as the "''Frost Dimension''". ==Notes== {{StoryNavBox}}
